hero.lede: Arcanum is a tarot reader that answers the question you actually have, not today's daily card and not a wait for a human reader. Ask, and the deck responds in the time it takes to shuffle.
hero.ctaGhost: See how the reading is built ↓

mechanism.title: Three moves, one continuous instrument.
mechanism.subtitle: No sign-up flow, no scrolling through a list of readers you don't know. Say what you're asking, and watch the mechanism do the rest.

ask.title: Name the question
ask.body: Not your birth chart. Not a vague mood. The actual decision in front of you. Arcanum reads for that, the same way a good reader would push you to get specific.

draw.title: The deck draws itself
draw.body: A real shuffle of the full seventy-eight cards, major and minor arcana, upright and reversed, pulled fresh for your spread. Never a cached "card of the day."

read.title: Interpretation, tied to your words
read.body: The reading comes from what you asked and the cards that landed, with meanings tied to their position. Not a generic paragraph that could answer anyone's question.

deck.title: Seventy-eight cards, catalogued and current.
deck.subtitle: Every card the instrument can draw is real, from the major arcana through the court cards, each with its own upright and reversed meaning. No shortened "app deck."

reading.tag: Plate IV — A Reading, In Progress
reading.title: What the instrument actually gives back.
reading.subtitle: Not a horoscope-style paragraph — a reading built from the cards that fell and the question you asked.
reading.question: “Should I take the new role, or stay where things are steady?”

chariot.title: The Chariot, upright
chariot.body: you've already been steering this, deliberately, longer than you're giving yourself credit for.

wheel.title: Wheel of Fortune, upright
wheel.body: the timing isn't yours to control, but it is turning; staying still doesn't keep it from moving.

strength.title: Strength, upright
strength.body: the steadier choice isn't the safer one here. It asks for patience with a version of yourself you're trying to outgrow

compare.title: No horoscope feed. No booking calendar either.
compare.subtitle: Both existing paths cost you something Arcanum doesn't ask for.

final.body: Bring the question that's really on your mind. Arcanum reads for that, not for whichever mood happens to match yours today.

footer.copyright: © Arcanum — an instrument, not an oracle of certainty.

gameSelect.title: How deep do you want to go?
gameSelect.lede: Every spread reads the same seventy-eight cards. What changes is how much of the question they're asked to cover.

single.name: One Card
single.description: Quick and direct. Good for a daily focus, a pointed piece of advice, or going deeper on one specific question.

three.name: Three Cards
three.description: Versatile. The same triad of cards can be framed several ways — choose the framing below.

horseshoe.name: Horseshoe
horseshoe.description: A middle ground between three cards and the Celtic Cross: past, present, hidden influences, obstacles, surrounding influences, advice, and likely outcome.

celtic.name: Celtic Cross
celtic.description: The classic ten-card spread for one specific question, in real depth: present, challenge, foundation, recent past, best outcome, near future, you, environment, hopes and fears, and outcome.

gameBoard.title: Draw your cards.

questionStep.lede: Open questions make for richer readings. Be specific about the actual decision in front of you — not a mood, not a yes or no.
